title: Close-up of optical/camera modules on black metal optical breadboard in lab space
objects_and_counts: One small black cube-shaped device with a lens mounted on top, located near the center-right of the image on a black metal plate; the lens assembly is visible and the cube is fully in frame.

One larger black assembly with a visible cylindrical lens element at the left-middle edge of the image; this assembly is partially cropped by the image left border (at least one larger optical module visible, cropped).

One exposed electronic circuit board with multiple white connector housings and coloured wires (red, yellow, black) in the lower-left foreground; the board is partially visible and partially out of focus.
Several metal fasteners (screws) visible in the black metal plate where the cube and assemblies are mounted; at least three screw heads are visible on the plate surface in the photographed area.
A row of tall enclosed cabinets or racks with glass doors is visible in the distant background at the right side of the image; at least three vertical cabinet sections are visible.
spatial_relations: The small black cube-shaped device with lens sits on top of a flat black metal plate toward the center-right of the frame.
The larger black assembly with a cylindrical lens is positioned to the left of the cube and is partially cropped by the left image edge.
The exposed circuit board with connectors and colored wires is in the lower-left foreground, in front of and below the plane of the mounted optical assemblies.
The row of tall glass-doored cabinets is positioned in the background on the right side of the image, behind the mounted plates and devices.
Multiple screw heads and mounting holes are arranged along and across the black metal plate, forming the mounting surface for the cube and other assemblies.
colours_and_materials: Black metal mounting plates and black plastic or metal housings for the optical assemblies dominate the foreground.
The lens elements appear dark/glossy black with reflective surfaces.
The circuit board in the lower-left foreground has a typical green-brown PCB colour with white plastic connector housings and red/yellow/black insulated wires.
The floor visible in the background appears light blue and the walls are white; the tall cabinets in the background have glass or transparent doors and a light-coloured frame.
uncertainties: The small side and panel labels on the black cube and the larger assembly contain additional text that is not legible at the image resolution; only 'Class 1 Laser Product' on a yellow label and 'M6020' are readable.
The exact device types, brand names (beyond 'M6020' fragment), model numbers and functions cannot be determined from visible appearance alone.
The larger left optical assembly is partially cropped by the image edge, so the full count and extent of that assembly are uncertain.
No room name or number is visible anywhere in the image, so the precise location cannot be established from this image.
The number of cabinets/racks in the full room cannot be determined; at least three vertical sections are visible but the total is unknown.
